mapper.sql: (m.qualification_id IS NOT NULL AND (m.qualification_state NOT IN ('APPROVED','REVOKED') OR m.valid_from IS NULL OR m.verified_at IS NULL OR m.verified_by IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(m.verification_reference),'') IS NULL)) OR e.id IS NULL OR e.aggregate_type<>'MENTOR' OR e.aggregate_id<>m.person_id OR e.aggregate_version<>m.revision OR r.id IS NULL OR r.event_id<>e.id OR NOT COALESCE(r.result_json=e.after_json,FALSE) OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.after_json,'$.position'))<>m.position OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.after_json,'$.affiliation'))<>m.affiliation OR NOT COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.after_json,'$.version'))=CAST(m.revision AS CHAR),FALSE) OR NOT (NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.after_json,'$.qualificationId')),'null') <=> m.qualification_id) OR (m.qualification_state='REVOKED' AND NOT COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.after_json,'$.qualificationStatus'))='REVOKED',FALSE)) OR (m.qualification_state='APPROVED' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.after_json,'$.qualificationStatus'))='REVOKED') OR (m.qualification_id IS NOT NULL AND (q.id IS NULL OR q.aggregate_type<>'MENTOR' OR q.aggregate_id<>m.person_id OR q.operation<>'APPROVE' OR q.source<>'ADMIN_VERIFIED_SOURCE' OR NOT COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.after_json,'$.qualificationId'))=q.id,FALSE) OR NOT (NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.after_json,'$.verifiedByUserId')),'null') <=> CAST(m.verified_by AS CHAR)) OR NOT (NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.after_json,'$.verificationReference')),'null') <=> m.verification_reference) OR NOT (CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.after_json,'$.validFrom')),'null'),'T',' '),'Z','') AS DATETIME(6)) <=> m.valid_from) OR NOT (CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.after_json,'$.validUntil')),'null'),'T',' '),'Z','') AS DATETIME(6)) <=> m.valid_until) OR NOT (CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.after_json,'$.verifiedAt')),'null'),'T',' '),'Z','') AS DATETIME(6)) <=> m.verified_at)))
